Purpose and availability

Bounty for Android is operated by Kunal Das personally. It helps you keep shared-expense records, calculate allocations, record settlements and track private borrowed or lent loans with supplied dues and actual repayments. Recording a settlement or repayment does not transfer money or verify that a bank payment occurred. Supplied EMI schedules are records you enter, not a calculated interest split or a lender-confirmed balance. Unknown principal or payment components remain unknown. Bounty does not connect a bank account or provide a bank, wallet, lending or money-transfer service.

Local and Demo remain separate; signing in does not automatically upload either workspace. Cloud sharing, invitations and remote receipts are paused. Features depend on supported devices, provider availability and subscription status. Bounty is intended as a general-audience app in Google Play-supported countries.

Your records and account

Review amounts, participants, currencies, shares, receipt text and imported data before relying on them. Review loan opening balances, schedule coverage, payment classifications and due applications against your own records. An incomplete supplied schedule does not mean nothing else is owed. Calendar exports are snapshots that do not update after payments or schedule changes. Keep your own records for payments, taxes or agreements with others. A balance records what users entered; it does not establish that a payment occurred or resolve a dispute between participants.

Only use or share information you have permission to use. Avoid unnecessary sensitive information about yourself or other people. Protect your device and Google account, and contact support if you believe your Bounty account is being used without authorization.

Keep exports and original receipt files where you can recover them. A ledger backup includes attachment references, not attachment bytes. Device loss, cleared app storage or unsupported storage can affect access to local records.

Pro subscriptions

Bounty Pro offers optional advanced insights, creation or changes to recurring expense rules, and supported receipt text scanning. Core splitting, recorded settlements, manual private loan and repayment tracking, supplied loan schedules, calendar exports, manual itemization and ledger exports do not require Pro. Existing ledger records and recurring rules remain accessible when Pro ends.

Where Google Play offers a plan, the app displays its localized price and billing period before purchase. Monthly and yearly are alternative auto-renewing plans. Manage renewal with Google Play; uninstalling Bounty, signing out or deleting an account does not cancel a subscription.

Read Subscription information for restore, availability and account-identity limits. No free trial, lifetime plan or unavailable Cloud benefit is advertised. Refund and cancellation rights follow the purchase provider and applicable requirements.

Questions and account requests

Contact kunal26das@gmail.com for support, privacy questions or account requests. Do not send passwords, sign-in codes, tokens or full payment-card details. A support request does not itself cancel a purchase or confirm account deletion.

Privacy policy and Account and data deletion explain data handling, retention and verified requests. We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 calendar days and handle them within 30 days, with an explanation of additional verification or delays. These operating aims do not limit applicable consumer or privacy rights.
